name: popsicle
headline: AI Marketing Content Creator for Businesses
short_description: AI-powered marketing image generator using Flux AI model. Creates professional visuals, A/B testing variations, and social media-optimized images for marketers and content creators.
author: ThunderBolt4931

sections.overview:
AI Marketing Content Creator generates high-quality marketing visuals using the Flux AI model running on Modal Labs H200 GPUs. It offers single image generation with style presets, A/B testing batch generation with multiple testing strategies, and platform-optimized social media packs for Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube. The tool includes an AI prompt assistant powered by Mistral API that helps users write professional prompts and optimize content for different platforms. Perfect for content creators, marketers, and businesses who need professional visuals without design expertise, it reduces production time from hours to minutes.
Generate product photography and marketing announcement visuals
Create A/B testing variations to optimize social media performance
Produce platform-specific images for Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook
Generate AI-assisted prompts for consistent marketing visuals
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ThunderBolt4931/AI-Marketing-Content-Creator`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing content creator for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Generate a 3-part social media campaign to promote [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Include a hook, key message, and call-to-action for each post. Use a conversational tone and keep each post under 280 characters.
```
